touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Hodnet qualifies as a local detour through Motte and bailey castle on Castle Hill, and the associated remains of a park pale, a fishpond and a formal garden and CHURCH OF ST LUKE. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
